root: ^MARA: Another night of... pretending I'll actually sleep.
^MARA: I keep thinking if I get tired enough, my brain will shut up for a while.
^MARA: But it never really does, does it?
^MARA: You've got it figured out though, huh? Just... close your eyes and sleep...
^MARA: Maybe I'll slay those nightmares tonight...wouldn't that be something Selene?
